title: Codex capacity retry
description: Retry failed interactive Codex turns without changing the terminal display. Any user input cancels a pending retry.

settings.name: enabled
settings.description: Automatically submit continue after a capacity error.

settings.name: step_seconds
settings.description: Added to the delay for each consecutive retry (30, 60, 90 ... with the defaults).

settings.name: jitter
settings.description: Random fraction added to or taken from each delay (0.2 = plus or minus 20%).

settings.name: max_attempts
settings.description: Maximum automatically submitted retries per streak; zero only rings the bell.

settings.name: submit_pause_seconds
settings.description: Pause between typing continue and pressing Enter, so Codex does not mistake Enter for a pasted newline.
